rationale: All 8 runs are feasible with wide hold (>=0.07 ns) and slew/cap headroom, so constraints are not binding; T_eff tracks the target and the recipe. AREA 3 runs beat DELAY runs at similar targets (md5 6.955 at 7.75, picorv32 7.556 at 8.15 vs DELAY 7.30 and 7.64), and the best run, md5, uniquely combines AREA 3 with ABC buffering+sizing, timing-driven placement, both post-GRT repairs and cap213. Setting 1: md5 recipe at the tightest allowed target (0.45 = 7.02 ns), close to the 6.955 already reached, so T_eff should survive re-check. Setting 2: same, but larger setup margins (0.35/0.25) so repair aims below the 7.02 ns floor of period_frac.
